name: Gmina Krzeszowice (Poland)
description: Red field charged at the centre with white charges from the gmina arms — a heraldic mark, a double cross and a mount — with a yellow bar.
history: Polish gmina flags are established by resolution of the gmina council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.

features.role: heraldic mark, double cross and mount from the gmina arms
